subject: paper-plumed puffin
art_direction: 胖海雀的头冠是一束纸灯穗，奶油腹部与孔雀蓝背面分色，低头检查脚尖。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Model a stout puffin-like bird as a hand-painted wooden sculpture, with a cream belly, peacock-blue back, and a short terracotta beak. Replace its head feathers with a fan of folded paper lantern tassels that sway to one side. It looks down at one lifted foot as if inspecting it. Keep the proportions compact, with a broad oval body and tiny wings. Set the sculpture against warm ochre, lit softly from the upper left. Show carved tool facets and worn paint edges without artificial dirt or a toy-store backdrop. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
